setup.title: Werewolf Game Setup
setup.systemDescription: The system will randomly assign roles to each player. Each player can view their role privately.
setup.cardsDescription: Players draw physical cards, then each one picks their role from the full list. Any roles, any mix.
setup.needMorePlayers: You need at least 5 players to start the game
setup.rolesMismatch: You need exactly {{count}} roles selected to match the player count. Currently selected: {{selected}}
setup.customizeRolesDescription: Use + / − to set how many of each role. The total must equal the number of players ({{playerCount}}).
setup.badWolfCount: Need at least 1 werewolf, and fewer werewolves than everyone else

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: Each night the pack wakes together and picks one non-werewolf to kill. Werewolves win when they equal or outnumber everyone else alive.

wolf-cub.name: Wolf Cub
wolf-cub.description: On the werewolf team and wakes with the pack. The Seer sees a werewolf. If the Wolf Cub dies in any way, the werewolves kill two players the next night.
wolf-cub.nightAction: Wake with the werewolves and choose the victim together

villager.name: Villager
villager.description: No special power. Watch, argue and vote by day to find the werewolves. Wins when every werewolf is dead.

seer.name: Seer
seer.description: Each night, pick one player. The moderator shows whether they are on the werewolf team (the Wolf Cub counts as a werewolf).

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.description: Each night, protect one player: they cannot die that night in any way (bite, poison or Huntress). May protect themself, but not the same player two nights in a row.
doctor.nightAction: Pick one player to protect (not last night's)

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.description: Each night, guard one player: they cannot die that night in any way (bite, poison or Huntress). May guard themself, but not the same player two nights in a row.
bodyguard.nightAction: Pick one player to guard (not last night's)

witch.name: Witch
witch.description: Has one heal potion and one poison, each usable once per game. Wakes after the werewolves and learns who they attacked. The heal saves that player (herself included); the poison kills any one player unless they are protected. May use both on the same night.
witch.nightAction: See who was attacked, then heal and/or poison

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: When the Hunter dies (bitten, voted out or poisoned), they immediately shoot one player, who dies too. They may choose not to shoot.

spellcaster.name: Spellcaster
spellcaster.description: Each night, silence one other player. The next day that player may not speak or vote, but can still be voted out.
spellcaster.nightAction: Pick one player to silence tomorrow

huntress.name: Huntress
huntress.description: Village team. Once per game, at night, she may kill one player (a protected player survives). The moderator calls her every night, even after she has used it, so nobody can tell.
huntress.nightAction: Kill one player, or skip (once per game)

tough-guy.name: Tough Guy
tough-guy.description: Village team. If the werewolves bite him and nobody saves him, he does not die yet: he lives through the next day and can vote, then dies at the following dawn.

doppelganger.name: Doppelgänger
doppelganger.description: On the first night, pick one player. When that player dies, you secretly take over their role and team (pick a werewolf and you become one). Until then you count as village. The moderator will tell you when you change.
doppelganger.nightAction: First night: pick the player you will copy when they die

tanner.name: Tanner
tanner.description: Sick of life and on nobody's side. Wins alone, and the game ends, if the village votes him out. Dying any other way is a loss. The Seer sees him as not a werewolf.

roleReveal.title: Role Reveal Phase
roleReveal.instruction: Each player should click the 'Reveal' button below their name to see their role privately.
roleReveal.allRevealed: All players have seen their roles!
roleReveal.secretlyViewRole: Each player should secretly view their assigned role.
roleReveal.selectRoleFromCard: Each player should select the role from their physical card.

night.title: Night Phase
night.noRolesWithNightActions: No living role wakes up tonight.
night.allActionsCompleted: All night actions have been completed. Dawn approaches...
night.extraKill: The Wolf Cub died: pick 2 victims tonight
night.huntressUsed: Already used her shot. Keep calling her anyway so nobody can tell.
night.doppelChanged: Doppelgänger {{player}} is now {{role}}. Tell them secretly.

day.title: Day Phase
day.discussionDescription: Discuss, then vote. The majority may eliminate one player, or no one.
day.silenced: {{players}} must stay silent today: no talking, no voting (can still be voted out)
day.hunterPrompt: {{player}} was the Hunter. Pick who they take down with them.
day.confirmLynchDescription: The village can eliminate only one player per day. This cannot be undone.
day.alreadyLynched: The village has voted today. Go to night when ready.

result.title: Game Over
result.werewolvesWinDescription: The werewolves have outnumbered the villagers and taken over the village.
result.villagersWinDescription: The villagers have eliminated all the werewolves and saved their village!
result.thanksMessage: Thank you for playing! Hope you enjoyed the game.
result.tannerWinDescription: The village voted out the Tanner, which is exactly what he wanted.
